id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

userUpdatedFields.description:
System managed field that keeps track of which fields in the seed data obj were updated by a user (as opposed to
the provisioner/authorizer).  Fields in seed data objs that are updated by users will not have those changes
overridden by provisioning.

hidden.description:
Field that marks a seed data obj as hidden.  When a seed data obj that was created via provisioning (e.g owned by
c3), user removals of that obj are handled by marking the obj as hidden to prevent future provisioning from causing
them to reappear.

userOwned.description:
A seed data entry is considered to be user owned if either this flag is true or the {@link Meta#created created}
field of {@link Persistable#meta} is not the authorizer or provisioner.  This field is completely managed by the
system.  It will be set while creating an entry if it is being created by the authorizer and the
{@link UpsertSpec#forceUserUpdate} is set to true.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

frozen.description: If true, then the pipe shall not be retrained

trained.description: True if training has succeeded and false otherwise.

flattenInput.description: If true, the underlying model only accepts flattened input.

hyperparamOverrides.description: The hyperparameters overridden of a native model or pipe.

hyperparamSearchSpace.description:
A collection of {@link Hp.ParamSpace}s for the hyperparameters of this pipe. This search space will be used to
perform hyperparameter searches.

hpoSpec.description:
Used to provide configuration for {@link #search}. Some configurations include how to validate results, which
search algorithms will be used, and limits on execution iterations.

hpoExperiment.description: {@link Hpo.Experiment} stores the result of hyperparameter optimization to find the best model/pipeline.

experiment.description: Reference to the experiment that produced this {@link MlPipe}. For example, this could be a {@link Hpo.ExperimentBase}.

modelFiles.description:
Map of urls of saved model files
key - model file name, value - {@link Url} corresponding to model file name

customModelCode.description:
A map containing {Module Name: Compressed Source Code} key-value pairs. The module name is the name of the
module from where the source code was taken from. (i.e. numpy).

processFunc.description: Name for the function on the native model to call to do {@link MlProcessable#process}.

underlyingPipe.description:
A pipe that contains the native model and implements {@link MlAtomicPipe#doProcess} and optionally
{@link MlAtomicPipe#doTrain}. If set, the implementation of the APIs on the `MlAtomicPipe` interface will be
dispatched through the underlying pipe. Otherwise, the developer has an additional responsibility to implement the
APIs.
DEVELOPER NOTE: If sub-types of {@link MlTemplate.AtomicPipe} is designed to have `underlyingPipe`, it is required to
override {@link MlTemplate.AtomicPipe#hasUnderlyingPipe} and return `True`

controlValvesModelable.description:
Do not set this field manually, this is set from the {@link ReliabilityRiskMl.ControlValvesReconstructionPipeline} to
point its corresponding {@link ReliabilityRiskMl.ControlValvesReconstructionPipeline#controlValvesModelable}.

This method references the modelable object responsible for the training and processing of the control valves reconstruction.

regressor.description:
The regressor that must be used for reconstructing the target variable.
For the {@link ControlValvesModelableBase} and {@link ControlValvesModelable} types, this is used to reconstruct
the PERCENT_OPEN expected sensor value from control valve data.

**Model Requirements:**
- This field must use a tree-based or linear model (e.g., LightGBM or linear regression) to generate feature contributions.
- The regressor will be responsible for modeling the PERCENT_OPEN sensor reading.

This field must be set to a model capable of fitting the regression task for control valve data.

hasTrainedModel.description:
Used internally by the pipe to determine whether a regressor model has been trained on the input data.
This field should not be set manually, it is managed automatically by the system.

actionRequirement.description:
Action requirement that specifies the necessary dependency for running the model.
This field enforces the use of `py-data-science-lightgbm` for training and inference.

title:
A template {@link ReliabilityRiskMl.ReconstructionPipeline#reconstructionPipe} that is used to model Control Valves.
This pipe performs the reconstruction of the target variable, which in the case of control valves, is typically
the PERCENT_OPEN sensor value that represents the control valve's operational state.

The {@link doTrain} and {@link doProcess} APIs of this pipe rely on the {@link #controlValvesModelable #controlValvesModelable#doTrainReconstruction}
and {@link #controlValvesModelable #controlValvesModelable#doProcessReconstruction} APIs to provide concrete implementations for the
training and processing of this reconstruction pipe.

**Usage:**
- This template pipe is used for reconstructing missing or inaccurate sensor data related to control valves.
- The modelable control valve methods are used for training the model (`doTrain`) and applying it during inference (`doProcess`).
- The reconstruction task focuses on predicting the PERCENT_OPEN value for control valves based on the available data.
- The pipe is flexible, supporting different types of regression models for reconstruction depending on the setup (tree-based, linear models, etc.).

**Main Components:**
- **controlValvesModelable**: A private method for linking the modelable methods for training and processing the reconstruction pipeline.
- **regressor**: A required regressor (e.g., tree-based or linear model) used to model the PERCENT_OPEN sensor readings from control valves.
- **hasTrainedModel**: An internal field indicating whether the model has been trained for the input data.

The reconstruction pipe is configured for a LightGBM-based regressor (`py-data-science-lightgbm`), which is a high-performance
tree-based model suitable for regression tasks such as this one.
name: ReliabilityRiskMl.Reconstruction.ControlValvesPipe
